Students must meet with the program director in the semester preceding the internship and may be required to secure their own program-approved site. Students must complete and pass a criminal background check and health/drug screen at their own expense, at least 60 days before enrolling in an internship by using the current approved RRCC background check and drug screen program. Students must complete all required courses with a grade of C or higher including passing all psychomotor, cognitive, and affective competencies prior to internship

MOT 1082.text: All program students must complete and pass a criminal background check and health/drug screen at their own cost, at least 60 days before enrolling in an internship by using the current approved RRCC background check and drug screen program. Students must also provide proof of all required immunizations, submit a physician’s approval/health form, and provide a valid BLS CPR card. Additionally, students must complete all required courses with a grade of C or higher including passing all psychomotor, cognitive, and affective competencies prior to internship. Successful completion of all MAP Certificate courses and MOT 1081. Program Director permission required

MOT 1084.text: All program students must complete and pass a criminal background check and health/drug screen at their own expense, at least 60 days before enrolling in an internship by using the current approved RRCC background check and drug screen program. Students must also complete all required courses with a grade of C or higher. Students are responsible for selecting an appropriate professional site for the internship, which must be approved by the program director in the semester preceding the internship. If students are unable or choose not to secure their own site, they should instead register for the online 7-week capstone course, MOT 2089, to complete their Billing and Coding Certificate
